### [Recommended] Installing WordParty for OmikujiBot

This "OmikujiBot" is designed around the effects of [WordParty for OmikujiBot](https://booth.pm/ja/items/6048048). Installing this WordParty makes your stream more colorful and fun to watch.

- Sound effects and animations are added to the characters' lines.
- Omikuji results and rock-paper-scissors outcomes are displayed in a visually clear way.

For details, see the [WordParty for OmikujiBot README](/core/OmikenWordParty/README.md).
